meaningKo: 진행 중인 일이나 프로젝트를 중단하거나 종료하다.
exampleEn: The company decided to pull the plug on the project due to budget issues.
exampleKo: 회사는 예산 문제로 프로젝트를 중단하기로 결정했다.
gameExamples: After months of discussions, the team chose to pull the plug on the collaboration.
The government decided to pull the plug on the outdated program that was not serving its purpose.
Faced with continuous setbacks, the manager had no choice but to pull the plug on the new product launch.
